scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
changes: Uses source-identical copies of existing Rust entry/body internally, except private names, internal dispatch and one matching tracked-free on nonzero group result. Entry rebind retains previous private counter-failure wrapper.
Does not alter exported generic helper ABI or generic callback contracts; caller errors and all later failure paths stay unchanged.
assumptions: Exact selected group helper returns errors before writing external list or leader counters. The event remains unshared despite its own group_leader pointer being populated on one failure branch.
The selected counter provider only scans, without reservation or publication; matched allocation and free providers and source bindings are those in prior perf-counter-failure-source-1/RESULT.json.
Caller supplies live synchronized group and descriptor objects as required by the existing group helper; this candidate does not solve existing concurrent traversal/leader ownership.
Compositor must append binding and register private module as a Rust source dependency; paired ABI, code review, compiler/linker and runtime are unproved.
open: After group success, sibling linkage and leader pmc_status are published. Host failure, allocation failure after host fd success, descriptor lifetime and rollback/host-close require exact independent ownership and synchronization; no cleanup on these branches is proposed.
